title: Controlled finite-channel minimizers regress toward the selected analytic tangent

regression.quadratic_ratio_extrapolation: Fit (p-p0)/sqrt(q) and (a-a0)/sqrt(q) quadratically in sqrt(q). Order 180 gives (-0.1040829661,-0.1291471442); order 120 gives (-0.1023667741,-0.1263107838). Both lie within 0.0023 of the analytic tangent componentwise.
regression.controls: Orders 120 and 180 agree in objective below 6e-21 on the grid; every four-start spread is below 8e-21. Coordinate flatness is retained as a numerical-conditioning caveat rather than hidden.

scope_guard: The regression is a controlled consistency check for the exact local tangent theorem. It is not an interval proof, a unique finite-strength branch certificate or a whole-chart optimization theorem.
